text: CI protects every change to the project, but something still has to run the pipeline every night. This lesson builds that something: an Airflow DAG.
Three tasks, one strict order: extract fresh rows from SQL Server into Snowflake, run dbt to build every model, then test them -- each step gated on the one before it actually succeeding.
Scheduled for 2am, after Brightleaf's own nightly batch jobs close out, with safeguards against two nights ever overlapping or silently backfilling a missed run.
A dedicated alert task fires if any one of the three steps fails, for any reason -- so a bad night produces a loud alert and yesterday's safe data, never a silent gap.
The pipeline now runs itself, reliably, every night. Next: Finance says the number still doesn't match -- and this time, the real bug hunt begins.
